g.text: A good pooled calibration curve can hide drug differences

text.style: font-size: 11px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #788a96

g.text: Selected model | test outcomes in validation-defined bins | open circles mark sparse bins

text.style: font-size: 12px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: middle; fill: #203743
font-size: 12px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #203743
font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #788a96

g.text: The dashed line marks exact agreement. Larger points mark larger bins; lines show 95% patient-bootstrap intervals (500 draws). Sparse means fewer than 100 rows

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #788a96

g.text: or fewer than 20 resistant results in a bin. Intervals are pointwise and do not prove calibration across all probabilities.
